title: Solar Site Survey Maintenance Log Form
subtitle: An original solar site survey workflow that carries planned or condition-based maintenance through safe release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete solar site survey maintenance log form for the proposed photovoltaic site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when service personnel need one record for maintenance trigger, asset baseline, work-control references, recurring events, readings, deferred defects, and qualified return-to-service approval. The survey coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Solar site survey maintenance log identity and ownership
sections.guidance: Define the maintained system, service interval, operating owner, and review period.

sections.title: Solar site survey asset baseline and maintenance readiness
sections.guidance: Reconcile the exact asset and known condition before maintenance or testing begins.

fields.label: Roof plane or ground area ID

blocks.label: Planned maintenance task set
items: Confirm property, service, and proposed array-area identity
Measure accessible roof plane or ground footprint
Map orientation, pitch, obstructions, and shade sources
Document roof covering and visible condition
Capture service, meter, and panel label evidence from safe access
Trace a non-invasive conceptual equipment and conduit route
Record access, staging, drainage, and maintenance constraints
Collect load-history and future-load references
Identify permitting, utility, and property-control dependencies
Prepare structural and electrical questions for qualified review

sections.title: Solar site survey work control and safe service boundary
sections.guidance: Record the qualified roles and controlling references; do not use this log as the controlling procedure.

blocks.label: Service readiness confirmations
items: Current procedure, manufacturer information, and applicable requirements were reviewed
Asset boundaries, every energy source, and affected systems were identified
Authorized, affected, contractor, and operations roles were coordinated
Isolation, stored-energy control, and verification references are complete
Required tools, instruments, parts, and protective controls are available
Test, temporary energization, and return-to-service steps have explicit authority
Customer, public, traffic, environmental, and critical-service impacts are controlled
Stop conditions and emergency escalation path are understood

blocks.label: Maintenance stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer. Maintenance stays restricted when isolation, stored energy, system condition, or work scope is unknown. Only the designated authorized person may direct changes to controls and the qualified release owner may approve return to service.

sections.title: Solar site survey maintenance events, condition, and readings
sections.guidance: Create a traceable history of work completed, condition found, evidence, and deferred action.

fields.label: Wear pattern, recurring fault, consumable trend, configuration change, and supporting evidence

sections.title: Solar site survey exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Unprotected roof edge, unstable ladder, or unsafe access
Wet, damaged, loose, or storm-affected roof or PV components
Exposed conductors, open electrical parts, arcing, or burn marks
Structural movement, severe deterioration, or falling-object exposure
High wind, lightning, ice, heat, or other unsafe weather
Unknown energized equipment or damaged wiring pathway
Blocked emergency access or uncontrolled public exposure
Any condition beyond the surveyor's authorization or training
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each maintenance exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Solar site survey decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Proposed photovoltaic site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
